observations.behavior: Adds Unity-specific session replay configuration and documentation including screenshot quality settings.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the frontend-facing instructions for users installing PostHog's Unity SDK with session replay.

observations.behavior: Updates Rust permission checks in feature flags and cache sanitization to recognize posthog-unity User-Agent alongside existing mobile clients.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows Unity traffic through session recording and caching restrictions without requiring domain whitelisting.

observations.behavior: Registers Unity as a selectable option within the Session Replay onboarding wizard flow.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes Unity available as an installation choice during user setup, connecting it to the broader session replay product.

observations.limitations: All changes are additive; no removals of legacy behavior or complex dependency resolution. No tests demonstrate end-to-end compatibility or performance impact. Documentation-only hunks do not establish runtime benefit.

review.limitations: All changes are additive; no removals of legacy behavior or complex dependency resolution. No tests demonstrate end-to-end compatibility or performance impact. Documentation-only hunks do not establish runtime benefit.
review.reason: Changes add a bounded capability (Unity support) across three independent layers: docs, UI selection, and backend permissions. The implementation is complete enough that its effect can be inferred from the code, but there is no systemic redesign or broad risk reduction demonstrated.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new supported platform for session recordings while preserving existing client compatibility. This could help PostHog reach Unity developers who currently lack this functionality.
review.uncertainty: No test execution or adoption metrics provided. Backend permission change assumes correct User-Agent headers in production traffic.
